code_generation.name: Unlimited-OCR
code_generation.summary: Unlimited-OCR是百度开源视觉语言模型，用于从图像中提取文本，涵盖多语言文档与场景照片。其基于Transformer特征提取及图像到文本生成技术，实现跨文字与版式的精准识别。优势包括广泛语言覆盖、稳健性能、MIT许可及社区应用广泛。典型用例涉及文档数字化、发票处理、自动化数据录入及生产级OCR流水线构建。
code_generation.summary_en: Unlimited-OCR is Baidu's open-source vision-language model that extracts text from images, including multilingual documents and scene photos. It uses transformer-based feature extraction and image-to-text generation, delivering accurate recognition across diverse scripts and layouts. Strengths include broad language coverage, robust performance, permissive MIT licensing, and strong community adoption. Typical use cases are document digitization, invoice/receipt processing, automated data entry, and building production-ready OCR pipelines.

rag.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
rag.summary: BGE-small-en-v1.5 是一个高效的英文句子嵌入模型，能够将文本转换为语义丰富的向量表示，专门解决文档相似度计算和语义搜索问题。它通过对比学习结合困难负样本挖掘，并采用知识蒸馏技术从大模型中学习，在保持轻量级的同时实现了优异的性能表现。开发者可将其用于构建智能检索系统、文档聚类分析，或作为RAG架构中的编码器，特别适合部署在计算资源有限的环境中探索语义理解应用。
rag.summary_en: BGE-small-en-v1.5 is a compact English sentence embedding model that converts text into meaningful numerical representations for semantic similarity tasks. It employs contrastive learning with hard negatives and knowledge distillation from larger models, achieving strong performance despite its small size. You can use it for semantic search, clustering similar documents, or as a lightweight encoder in retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, making it ideal for resource-constrained applications.

model_distillation.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
model_distillation.summary: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 是一个高效的句子嵌入模型，能将文本转换为有意义的向量表示，用于计算语义相似度。它通过知识蒸馏技术从大型模型中学习，仅用2270万参数就实现了接近大模型的性能，特别适合资源受限环境。开发者可通过Hugging Face快速调用该模型，应用于智能搜索、文档聚类或内容推荐等场景，探索语义理解在实际项目中的潜力。

model_distillation.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
model_distillation.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。

multilingual_processing.name: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
multilingual_processing.summary: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 是一个紧凑的多语言句子编码模型，专门解决跨语言语义理解难题，支持50多种语言的文本相似度计算。它通过知识蒸馏技术将大型多语言Transformer的能力压缩到轻量级12层架构中，同时保持跨语言语义对齐特性，让模型在不同语言间准确捕捉相同含义。开发者可直接用它构建多语言语义搜索系统、实现跨语言文档分类，或作为特征提取器用于下游NLP任务，只需输入任意支持语言的文本即可获得高质量的语义向量表示。

multilingual_processing.summary: Unlimited-OCR是百度开源视觉语言模型，用于从图像中提取文本，涵盖多语言文档与场景照片。其基于Transformer特征提取及图像到文本生成技术，实现跨文字与版式的精准识别。优势包括广泛语言覆盖、稳健性能、MIT许可及社区应用广泛。典型用例涉及文档数字化、发票处理、自动化数据录入及生产级OCR流水线构建。
multilingual_processing.summary_en: Unlimited-OCR is Baidu's open-source vision-language model that extracts text from images, including multilingual documents and scene photos. It uses transformer-based feature extraction and image-to-text generation, delivering accurate recognition across diverse scripts and layouts. Strengths include broad language coverage, robust performance, permissive MIT licensing, and strong community adoption. Typical use cases are document digitization, invoice/receipt processing, automated data entry, and building production-ready OCR pipelines.

multimodal_understanding_generation.summary_en: Unlimited-OCR is Baidu's open-source vision-language model that extracts text from images, including multilingual documents and scene photos. It uses transformer-based feature extraction and image-to-text generation, delivering accurate recognition across diverse scripts and layouts. Strengths include broad language coverage, robust performance, permissive MIT licensing, and strong community adoption. Typical use cases are document digitization, invoice/receipt processing, automated data entry, and building production-ready OCR pipelines.

model_compression.summary: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 是一个高效的句子嵌入模型，能将文本转换为有意义的向量表示，用于计算语义相似度。它通过知识蒸馏技术从大型模型中学习，仅用2270万参数就实现了接近大模型的性能，特别适合资源受限环境。开发者可通过Hugging Face快速调用该模型，应用于智能搜索、文档聚类或内容推荐等场景，探索语义理解在实际项目中的潜力。

vector_retrieval.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
vector_retrieval.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。
vector_retrieval.summary_en: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact BERT-based model optimized for text ranking and semantic search tasks, solving the challenge of efficient information retrieval from large text collections. It employs knowledge distillation to compress a larger teacher model into a smaller arc…
